label: Weighted sums
subgoals: Normalize the objectives to comparable scales
Compute the weighted score of every design
Pick the lowest score and note that only convex-hull points can win

label: Epsilon constraints
subgoals: Discard designs that violate the bound on the constrained objective
Minimize the remaining objective among those left
Sweep the bound to trace the front

label: Hypervolume of a front
subgoals: Keep only the nondominated designs and sort them by the first objective
Add each design's rectangle below the previous design's second objective
Sum the rectangles against the fixed reference point
